summary: V3-08 repair of trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35650859523. The finalizer release job failed at step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' (~20m59s) with all product/privacy/cost gates and the x86_64 release build passing. The candidate delta is exactly one line in app/index.tsx: openHousehold changes router.push('/add') to router.push('/(tabs)'), hypothesizing that the /add route broke the golden path. Independent verification DISPROVES this hypothesis: using the app's real route tree (getRoutes over the actual app directory) and the exact Expo Router 57.0.22 linking config (getNavigationConfig + fork/getStateFromPath, the precise function used by router.push via getNavigateAction -> store.linking.getStateFromPath), '/add' resolves to the valid state __root -> (tabs) -> add, while '/(tabs)' resolves to '+not-found' (the generated Unmatched Route screen, active because app.json sets no router.notFound=false and the app has no +not-found file). The candidate change would therefore make the golden path fail DETERMINISTICALLY at waitFor('Ajouter') after tapping 'Appartement' — the exact failure mode it claims to fix, now guaranteed by code instead of emulator flakiness. The /add route was never the blocker: run 35650859523 failed in the emulator/E2E infrastructure, the 17th+ consecutive finalizer emulator-step failure, all previous ones attributed to E2E-script/emulator issues (stuck detector, dump fragility, cold start) and none to navigation. Trusted verification exit code 0 (typecheck, 453 tests / 22 suites, privacy 71, cost 21, expo export, prebuild, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL) — but a green static suite cannot validate runtime navigation, and the finalizer contract tests are static checks that never assert the navigation route. Decision: reject — the delta is a single harmful line that must be discarded; the next cycle must keep router.push('/add') and repair the actual emulator/E2E blocker using the persisted diagnostics artifact (chorescore-v3-finalizer-diagnostics, id 10663681034) or step logs.

findings.problem: The candidate changes openHousehold from router.push('/add') to router.push('/(tabs)'). In Expo Router 57.0.22 with this app's route tree, '/(tabs)' does NOT resolve to the tabs layout: getStateFromPath returns the '+not-found' route (the generated Unmatched Route screen), because the (tabs) group has no index child and the group path itself is not a matchable URL. The golden path taps 'Appartement' then waits for 'Ajouter'; with this change the app would render 'Unmatched Route' and waitFor('Ajouter') would time out after 300s — the exact failure the candidate claims to fix, now made deterministic by code. The pristine '/add' route resolves correctly to __root -> (tabs) -> add and is the right navigation target.
findings.evidence: Empirical test with the app's real route tree (getRoutes over app/ files: root layout children index, group-options, invite, join/[token], (tabs), +not-found, _sitemap; (tabs) children add, balances, todos) and the exact linking config structure produced by getReactNavigationConfig/getNavigationConfig: getStateFromPath('/add', {screens}) => {"routes":[{"name":"__root","state":{"routes":[{"name":"(tabs)","state":{"routes":[{"name":"add","path":"/add"}]}}]}}]}; getStateFromPath('/(tabs)', {screens}) => {"routes":[{"name":"+not-found","params":{"not-found":["(tabs)"]},"path":""}]}. router.push resolves string hrefs via getNavigateAction -> store.linking.getStateFromPath (verified in node_modules/expo-router/build/global-state/getNavigationAction.js and store.js). shouldAppendNotFound() returns true (app.json sets no router.notFound=false; no app/+not-found file), so the +not-found route renders RootUnmatched. Git history: 50762dc introduced '/(tabs)' and was flagged in RUN_35138202361.md as ignoring the tapped group id; e993606 (human commit 'Fix group navigation to initial Add tab') added setCurrentHouseholdId(id) and switched to '/add', which is the correct route.
findings.requiredFix: Revert the candidate line: keep router.push('/add') in openHousehold (with setCurrentHouseholdId(id) as in the pristine baseline). Do not navigate to '/(tabs)' — it resolves to the Unmatched Route screen and would break the golden path deterministically.
findings.verification: Re-run the route-resolution test: getStateFromPath('/add') must return the __root -> (tabs) -> add state and getStateFromPath('/(tabs)') must return +not-found; the app/index.tsx diff must be empty vs the pristine accepted tree.

findings.problem: The candidate does not repair the actual trusted finalizer blocker. Run 35650859523 failed at step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' (~20m59s) with all gates and the x86_64 release build passing; the navigation route was never the cause ('/add' resolves correctly). This is the 17th+ consecutive finalizer emulator-step failure; every prior repair was E2E-script-only (stuck detector, dump cache, cold-start grace) and none has been validated on a real emulator because the finalizer is the only place the emulator runs. The candidate's navigation change is a guess that contradicts the route-resolution evidence and leaves the real blocker (emulator boot/install/cold-start/dump fragility or app runtime crash) unidentified.
findings.evidence: Public GitHub API for run 35650859523: conclusion failure; prepare success; release job step 5 gates success (70s), step 6 x86_64 build success (~10min), step 7 emulator E2E failure 20:36:13Z -> 20:57:12Z (20m59s), step 8 universal build skipped; diagnostics artifact chorescore-v3-finalizer-diagnostics (id 10663681034, 25.5MB) uploaded; reopen-on-failure committed 686a650. Step-7 raw logs return HTTP 403 (admin rights) and the artifact HTTP 401 (no token) from this environment. Prior audit RUN_35414682827.md documents that every actual finalizer run has failed at the emulator step (5/5 at that time; now 17+). The E2E script's own timing budget (launch ~60-140s + Demarrer up to 900s + Appartement up to 300s + Ajouter up to 300s) fits the 1259s step only if boot/install were fast; the failure point cannot be narrowed without the logs.
findings.requiredFix: Keep the pristine navigation ('/add') and investigate the actual emulator failure: download the chorescore-v3-finalizer-diagnostics artifact (id 10663681034) or read the step-7 logs (logcat-wait-*.txt, dumpsys-wait-*.txt, result.json, UI dump XML echoed to step stdout by scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh) to identify the concrete blocker (emulator boot, APK install, cold start, sign-in, dump fragility, app crash/ANR, or System UI overlay), then repair only that concrete blocker while preserving V3-01..V3-07.
findings.verification: The next trusted finalizer dispatch must pass the Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path step with the repaired baseline; the golden path must reach Ajouter/Balances/A faire and the demo entries with router.push('/add') in place.
